participant_source_file: participants.tsv from the DOI-pinned OpenNeuro v1.0.6 release
participant_source_pin: Use the immutable OpenNeuro v1.0.6 dataset release; the moving GitHub main/master branch is not the roster source of record.
selected_scope: Within-participant digit-span serial-recall instruction versus passive listening, matched within 5-, 9-, and 13-digit load; event-anchored encoding through common 3-second retention; exclude retrieval speech and ITI.
primary_mnj_exclusion_reason: Metadata describes event-defined trials, not a verified 120-180 seconds of uninterrupted same-condition dynamics.
technical_inclusion_rule: Screen source participants with EEG_excluded=no for paired event files and requested channel realizations. Freeze estimator-specific support/computability rules; impose no global duration gate; emit each computable measurement and use a named common-support intersection only for paired model comparisons.

preliminary_metadata_check.scope: sub-032 sample files from moving GitHub mirror only
preliminary_metadata_check.task_memory_eeg_json: RecordingDuration 7395.32 s; continuous mixed task; 63 EEG channels; FCz reference; Fpz ground; 1000 Hz
preliminary_metadata_check.task_rest_eeg_json: RecordingDuration 227.081 s (~3 min 47 s); task-rest file. The sidecar repeats TaskName mixed and the digit-span TaskDescription, while the data descriptor describes a nominal four-minute eyes-closed rest recording; reconcile the label and duration against the DOI-pinned release before using as rest.
preliminary_metadata_check.event_dictionary: per-digit control/memory markers encode load and item position; memory markers include recall correctness
